```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


## generate PI pairs

USing [M+H]+ feature as anchor, assign labels only to the neibouger feature (e.g. 5s, 10s), assign 1 when both found peak matching in to library and also with annotation. label 0 means negative or unsure in semi-supervised learning. 
```{r}

pairs_for_ml_StM16 <- generate_PI_pairs(annotate_peaks_StM16_result_df, rt_threshold = 10, ppm_tolerance = 20)

```
## RT similarity
```{r}


rt_sim_obj_StM16 <- calRTSimilarity(feature_table = result_StM16_FT_filtered,
                        feature_pairs = pairs_for_ml_StM16,
                        , method = "gaussian")


rt_sim_res_StM16 <- rt_similarity(rt_sim_obj_StM16)

head(rt_sim_res_StM16)

rt_distance_res_StM16 <- rt_distance(rt_sim_obj_StM16)

head(rt_distance_res_StM16)


```

## EIC similarity 
based on pre calculate feature pair with labels, we calcualte the pairwise feature EIC similarity

```{r}
# step 1:  Create the object
eicData_obj_StM16 <- new("EICData",
           features = result_StM16_FT_filtered,
           eic_data = result_StM16[[4]])

# step 2: Process EICs using Rcpp
eic_obj_StM16 <- feature_EIC_process(eicData_obj_StM16, nrows = nrow(result_PA14_FT_filtered), ncols = 9)

```


```{r}
# step 3: calculate pairwise EIC similarity

eic_result_StM16 <- EIC_cor_mat_pairs(
  feature_EIC_combined_result = eic_obj_StM16@parsed_EIC,
  feature_pairs = pairs_for_ml_StM16,
  rt_EIC_thr = 2.0,
  method = "pearson"
)

```




## sample intensity correlation

```{r}
StM16_corintensity <- CorIntensityPair(feature_table = result_StM16_FT_filtered, feature_pairs = pairs_for_ml_StM16,intensity_cols = 13:21)
```



```{r}
head(StM16_corintensity)
```




## Merge into one data frame




```{r}
library(dplyr)


merged_input_StM16 <- pairs_for_ml_StM16 %>%
  left_join(rt_sim_res_StM16, by = c("feature_1", "feature_2")) %>%

  left_join(eic_result_StM16, by = c("feature_1", "feature_2")) %>%
  left_join(StM16_corintensity, by = c("feature_1", "feature_2")) %>%
  
  mutate(
    rt_similarity = replace_na(rt_similarity, 0),
    cor_value = replace_na(cor_value, 0) ,
    EIC_similarity = replace_na(EIC_similarity, 0)
  )

head(merged_input_StM16,30)


```

## join the library annotation output

```{r}
head(direct_match_Stm16_res_MS1_df)
```

```{r}
merged_input_StM16_join_lib <- merged_input_StM16 %>% 
  left_join(., direct_match_Stm16_res_MS1_df[, c("Matched_features_to_peaks", "Lib_group","Compound_name")],by =c("feature_2"="Matched_features_to_peaks") )
```

```{r}
head(merged_input_StM16_join_lib,50)
```
